items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: One time boy when we played, he said he had been to the Craytax but he got all right.

ctx.x: He had lungs trouble. Oh, yeah, lungs trouble. Oh, yeah. One time boy when we played, he said he had been to the Craytax but he got all right.
Let's see. Ask him if he ever knew Lewis Dumain.
